scope: Brain acquired CT/MRI component only; whole archive may be staged as opaque bytes. No current scientific admission.

identity_source.source_metadata_conflict: The record prose says Task1 brain center B lacked MRI, but its training table and actual archive preview both enumerate 60 brain subjects in A/B/C; no correction of publisher text is claimed.

split.algorithm: SHA256 of UTF-8(namespace + exact subject_id); ascending hash then subject_id within anonymous center; one-based ranks 1..42 TRAIN, 43..51 SELECT, 52..60 MEASUREMENT_EVAL

family_policy.within_release: All CT, MRI, masks, overview images and future derivatives of an enumerated subject inherit its one role. Source challenge TRAIN is distinct from project roles.
family_policy.same_source_rerelease: Matching proven patient identities across rereleases inherit this role; changed identifiers require a crosswalk before joint admission.
family_policy.task2: Not acquired. Task1 and Task2 patients need not be the same; neither disjointness nor identity is inferred from task-prefixed numbers.
family_policy.other_release_or_dataset: Overlap with other SynthRAD releases or same-institution cohorts is unresolved. No claim of independent external validation. Conflicts must be resolved before training or measurement admission.

access.archive_transport: Opaque whole-object bytes permitted after root freezes contract; contains mixed project roles and other anatomy.
access.future_candidate_admission: Only explicitly listed acquired brain CT/MRI; only TRAIN may enter a future authorized training/admission workflow. SELECT and MEASUREMENT_EVAL remain protected from tuning.
access.all_other_members: QUARANTINED_UNREVIEWED; no default admission. Unknown identity, generated synthesis output, pelvis, outline mask, spreadsheets and overview pictures are not training admissions.
access.role_inheritance_for_outline: Recorded for ancestry only; no human skull/tumor/vessel-label claim.
